statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail is elevated during the active post-PPI and early cash-session repricing window.
recommendation: The published policy mapping is orange. Tail remains below the high band because exact current NQ failed-retracement structure is not verified; meaningful retracement and cross-asset stabilization would support normalization.
headline: Post-PPI cash-session pressure keeps Tail elevated as yields and oil surge
body: August PPI rose 0.4% month over month and 5.4% year over year, while initial jobless claims were 206,000. The Nasdaq Composite opened 0.88% lower, the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield moved above 4.9%, Brent crude exceeded $105 amid renewed Gulf shipping attacks, and Nvidia was about 2.2% lower in early cash trading. These aligned amplifiers lift Tail, but precise current NQ pullback depth and failed-retracement structure are not verified.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail moved from high during Wednesday's directional selloff to WATCH/low as mean reversion returned, then rebuilt Thursday morning. It reached 30% after the hot PPI and is now elevated as the cash open adds downside confirmation while yields, oil and technology weakness remain aligned.
outlookSummary: The active post-PPI/cash-open window remains the nearest path-risk focus through 15:00 UTC. Tail is forecast to ease if meaningful retracement develops, while the scheduled Oracle earnings call and Friday's 12:30 UTC CPI are the next major conditional checkpoints.
